reviews.comment: super heavy accent and gives 0 prep for exam aka no practice exam or review I dont know if she changed her exam but its nothing like the homeworks. memorize the textbook.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you spend enough time studying her full lecture slides every week before the quizzes, you will get an A. Her 314 isn't bad at all, and she is helpful as long as you ask questions. She sometimes gives extra credit during lectures, so make sure you attend classes. She gives free 1-2 points on exams and quizzes just for writing your name correctly.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I think Dr. Lee is a good professor, she may not be in the allstars of the Comp sci department, but I think she doesn't get the credit she deserves. She's a fairly good professor, she knows what she is talking about. She is also pretty caring. The only ding is its sometimes a little difficult to understand her lectures/slides. Very proof heavy.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee is a very fair professor. Homework assignments / quizzes on a regular basis, though they only take a couple hrs weekly. Quizzes match the formatting of tests, all of which have no "curveballs" that deviate from **what's on her slides**. very responsive over email, too. General 314 advice: you'll suffer greatly if you cram / wait to code! GL

She was a pretty bad lecturer, but there was a bunch of reading and supplemental materials which allowed you to keep up in class. Exams were all based off of homework or exercises, so they were easy to score well on. Attendance was mandatory though which meant most kids would do their own thing in class until mandatory assignments.

I think Professor Lee is a good teacher, especially if you can understand her English which isn't too bad compared to some other professors I've had. You can tell she really cares about her students. Although attendance is not taken, she will give random extra credit to students who show up. She grades the homework assignments harder than I'd like.

Very hard to follow. Take it slow, keep up with notes, and do well on the in class quizzes. Make sure to attend every class because she sometimes gives extra credit. The lecture slides are unnecessarily complex, so it helps to break things down, use outside resources, and take strong notes for the finals. Exams are all MCQ, similar to quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee is a great prof! She's very sweet and explains concepts well if you ask questions. She can move fast, but she's happy to slow down and help. Quizzes and exercises are similar to exams and covered in class. Since exams are all MCQ and pull from hw and class material, it isn't hard to do well in the class. She also gives out extra credit.

This professor will make you grow gray hairs. I promise you avoid at all costs. Her lectures are literally a joke. She will ramble for 20 minutes explaining something that has nothing to do or simply overcomplicating subjects that a 10 minute youtube lecture will suffice with. She is the worst when it comes to excused absences. Dont skip a lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Lots of reviews say her lectures are hard to understand, but her accent isn't that thick and she doesn't speak too fast. She goes pretty well into depth on most topics but sometimes speeds past certain things. The homeworks are a little tedious, but not exactly hard, and she gives lots of extra credit for exams.

The professor cannot teach. She reads math off of slides; I mean who does that? There are regular practice quizzes, and the homework is typed in latex and is graded quickly, but no feedback is provided. The class is easy if you are willing to learn on your own. The videos and slides are useless as she copies the textbook; reading the book is better
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Heavy accent.Lectures are copied from the textbook and often boring. Class material doesn't really help with exams. Homework helps a bit, but there's little practice overall. Attendance not mandatory, but quizzes/exercises mean you still need to go. Wouldn't recommend, course feels unnecessarily hard

Lectures feel not very useful and she has a heavy accent. There isn't enough practice material to prepare for exams. Exams are often long, averaging about 2 minutes per mcq, and most require deep understanding of the topic. Sometimes extra credit is offered after exams. Attendance is mandatory due to in-class quizzes and exercises.

Super slow speaker, normally goes off topic during lecture, and her slides are 1:1 copies of the textbook material. Homework is not too bad but usually harder for no reason compared to the exam. Her accent is quite hard to deal with at times. Her mandatory attendance makes you suffer because its gibberish the entire time. Would not recommend.
Should be fine if you thoroughly go through the slides and quizzes. Do NOT wait until exams to catch up on material.

Dr. Lee's lectures were not very helpful and I found myself zoning out a lot. Her accent is hard to understand sometimes and she also goes into depth about topics that are barely on her exams during lectures. Exams are worth a lot and are similar to quizzes/hw so I recommend going over those before each exam and the textbook isn't helpful at all.

Decent lecturer. All assignments were online and due by the end of the day. Pay attention to grading requirements as they are strict with those. The final exam was brutal. Had more questions than the midterm with the same amount of time. Show up, pay attention, and it will be fine.

Dr. Lee is a great professor; she's very caring and responsive, and gives lots of extra credit (curves test average to passing + simple worksheets in class). What's in her lectures is exactly what's on the test, so no surprises. If you read the textbook, and understand the HW problems+slide examples youll do well in class.

Idk why she has such a low rating on Rate my prof. She does have an accent but it is quite intelligible (unlike prof Leyk) She is one of the most caring profs, I've taken at TAMU so far. She really wants you to succeed. Gives good amount of extra credit on tests + more for attending class. The class does have a decent amount of hw-not an insane amt

Shes hard to understand during her lectures and her accent takes time to get used to but if you actively pay attention to lectures the class is definitely doable. Going to office hours is also very important in this class and the professor is very accessible, even through email. She gives a lot of extra credit so go to her lectures.

She attempts to help students but comes off condescending and rude when they genuinely try to participate and engage but make mistakes. It is difficult to dislike her because she seems very wholesome at times, but she is unreasonably harsh as well. She did offer a lot of extra credit as a grade boost near the end as Exam 2 was difficult.

For many students, Dr. Lee provides their first exposure to discrete math and the mathematical reasoning needed for college-level computer science. I'm assuming most of the poor reviews are by students who struggled and, instead of going to her TA's amazing office hours or emailing this hard-working, highly available professor, chose to blame her.

If their was a top 10 worst teachers, she would be #1-10 and a honorable mention. The only fun thing about this class is recognizing how poor of a teacher she is for an interesting class. If you see any rating above a 1, I promise you it's wrong. And B and and A is definitely manageable, but not worth the work, take a different teacher.

Took online async. Lecture videos were reading off PPT though some were useful. Homework was doable but often times annoying, vague, and involved a ton of writing, which made it unnecessarily tedious. Test aren't bad, just make sure you're on top of things and study the PPT and quizzes/exercises. Not the best but not terrible.

Does homework help in her office hours. Notation of Greek letters in particular is not tested on exam, just focus on practicing with real numbers.

She does not communicate equivalence classes clearly:
Equivalence Classes: start with remainder, add/subtract congruence modulo
Ex: congruence modulo 6, remainder 3: [3] = {...,-9,-3, 3, 9, 15,...}

In test 1/2 i was in my 60s, final was about 84, ended up with a B. She just sends a text book and says “have fun!”. I hated that she posts a module on Monday and wants me to do the quiz by Wednesday. I just don't have time in the first part of the week! This is a math and theory heavy class, avoid her if you can. This class took 90% of my time.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was just painful to do. Prof is non existent so u have to read the textbook but at the end of the day the textbook at times is just gibberish. There are 3 tests and u basically have 1-2 quizzes each week which are somewhat like the test but not exactly. The only good part about this class is that its completely online
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Just avoid this prof. She doesn't even know how to solve her own quiz problems. My friend and I went to office hours once and she just blankly stared at the problem and told us that she would email us an explanation..... definitely possible to do well in this class however as a prof shes basically nonexistent in the class

I can't believe I picked khanh nguyen thinking he'll be better than Lee for 314. She doesn't provide much explaination for the slides in lecture vids, and hws are a bit tedious but the material itself are not that hard; slides and hws reflect exams. Not the easiest class in the world but defintely not hard. She's an angel comapred to nguyen

Lectures were pretty slow but she's really happy to teach and gives good feedback. A midterm and final are each 25% of the grade and are pretty tough, but they each have reviews and are really similar to the weekly quizzes so they're doable. Other than the exams, the class is not hard.

Its a hard course paired with a subpar learning experience. Your best bet is to know the mastery quizzes, because that's what will show up on the test. Failed the 1st exam, passed the 2nd, aced the final with a 96 (SUIIIIIII). There's some extra credit and she curved the grades at the end because I ended with an 88 calculated but got an A in Howdy.

Her practice exercise videos are very helpful, but there isn't one for every topic, so expect a good amount of self-studying. The homework is not easy but helps quite a bit in preparing for tests. Free extra credit at the beginning of the semester + more on homework and tests can easily bring final grade up a few points.

If you put in the effort, you can easily get an A in the course and learn many valuable skills. If you enjoy math, you will have a blast with the homework problems. This class is very useful if you are pursuing math minor. The exams don't throw trick questions and are easy to study for. She was always willing to help and responded almost 24/7.
Her 314 is a lot better than her 222. Online class, pretty okay difficulty

Do not trust other ratings that are 4 or above. I don't know if Professor Lee bribed students, but she is one of the worst professors I have ever had. I literally spent 80% of my study time only in 222 because of her. She was unhelpful and uninterested in how students are doing in her class. This course made me want to pull out my hair.

All online class and she posts all lecture slides + videos over slides (pretty much just reads slides in videos). Homework + quiz every week + coding assignment every other week but most assignments werent hard. She made the final really hard but other than that, nothing that bad. Just a lot of work but she gives good feedback and helps a lot.

Genuinely one of the worst professors that I have ever had. Her online lectures were some of the most uninteresting and boring videos that I have ever watched. Also provides little to no relevant content to help prepare for exams. Also commonly uses "Have fun!" at the end of nearly every single assignment/thing that she posts which is infuriating.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She takes the time to give really good feedback and help you if you need help. The class was online and she sets it up so it's very easy to keep track of everything you need to do, but it is a very time consuming course. She is a good professor, but the course should not be taught online in general which is why most people struggle with her.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: 222 was a pretty difficult class for me but Dr.Lee made it a lot easier for me. She provides so much extra credit throughout the course and is very easy to reach outside of class. There are a lot of quizzes that can be difficult but reading the textbook will prepare you for them. I would definitely recommend her for this difficult class!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very math and comp sci theory heavy class, no actual coding. Class forces you to understand material rather than memorize. Uses LaTeX for homework which is annoying at first but easy to get used to. Textbook isn't always clear but her lecture videos explain the most important details to know. A lot of extra credit. Not a bad professor overall.

She's very nice, but, like with every professor that writes the textbook, she assumes you understand things sometimes. The tests are straight out of the practice quizzes which are straight out of the textbook. There were 6.4 points of extra credit on the overall grade, but take that with a grain of salt. Will be taking her again for 314.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Although I got an A, she is not a good professor; she is difficult to follow and some exam questions aren't exactly fair. However, the TAs (most, AVOID THE BAD TAs) can help with homework and concepts, so go to PTC and office hours. In the end, though, she's lowkey an easy professor; her exams mostly reflect the quizzes.

Very generous with extra credit, responds promptly if you reach out to her outside of class. The lecture videos are pretty difficult to follow; however, she frequently posts problem solving videos which clear up a lot of confusion. HW is somewhat tedious, but the questions tend to be harder than exams, so if you do it you'll be more than ready.

HW assignments usually worth more than 100 points. She gives free 40 bonus points to the homework category in the beginning of the year + test curves + extra credit (+25 points to exam category. EXAM category. Super generous) + quizzes not proctored. If you do good on first two exams, you can fail the final and still get A. Fun logic/puzzles class.

Take anybody but her. By far the worse professor. Terrible slides, terrible videos, terrible everything. I should've taken a different professor. She makes me want to end myself. I'd have rather taken this class my last semester of my senior year with a diff prof if it meant avoiding Hyunyoung Lee.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do you hate yourself? Do you want to mentally torture yourself? Then you got your solution right here! If you love 3-4 year recycled videos that basically reads off the slides, love slides that barely give you any important information, or love professor who refuses to teach and makes passive income from students, take this professor now!

There is a reason why Lee CONSISTENTLY HAS THE MOST STUDENTS Q-DROP (check the registrar grade distribution if you don't believe me; note-she only teaches in the fall). Kimberly Brehm and TrevTutor are what help me struggle through 222. Not her.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Lee is very smart and clearly knows discrete math. Does that make her a good professor? No. She re-uses 4 year old (horrible) videos, and expects you to play a scavenger hunt through her textbook to find the actual info you need. I enjoy doing the homework in Latex, I only hate the way she teaches. Id rather my tuition go to TrevTutor.
Please don't make the mistake of taking her class you'll regret it

Exams include content that you've probably never seen before. Lots of reading her textbook, which only sometimes makes sense; same with her videos. The TAs will save you. The homework is written using LaTeX, which has very nice formatting. But overall, she makes this class a lot harder than it needs to be, especially compared to the other profs.

CSCE 314 is my second class with Dr. Lee. I took CSCE 222 with her last semester and I must say I enjoyed my experience with her in 222 more than 314. The quizzes in 314 were insanely difficult and got harder by the week. The midterm and final were a huge chunk of the grade (50%). However, she is a super sweet person and stays up till 2 am to help
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures make no sense. Quizzes and exams are extremely hard. The icing on the cake is that she will assume you are cheating and honor code you before hearing you out. She is by far the worst professor in the entire university. Please take Lupoli for this class and avoid her at all costs. You will save your sanity that way.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: My experience with Dr. Lee has mixed feelings. On the good portion, Dr. Lee is highly reachable. She has responded all of my emails and discussion posts in less than 24 hours. She is also really clear with expectations for class. But, Dr. Lee's lectures are confusing, and the textbooks are verbose. Take her if you know how to self-study Well.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Honestly, I think Lee is a very fair prof. All the material is literally in the slides, if you take the time to watch her videos and study you will do well in the class. She also offers insane extra credit that bumped me to an A in 22 as well.

Literally the most difficult class and prof ever. She makes you use a dumb software for hw (only prof i heard that does this) and they take you like over a few hours each. The material is really difficult to grasp, her lecture videos/explanations are not helpful whatsoever if you can find a better prof, do it. If you're stuck, just keep pace/pray.

Lee is super easy to reach out to for questions and her office hours are great. Her context is naturally hard since it's mostly math, but most of her quiz questions come from her videos. Her test are usually similar to the quizzes. She also gives out a ton of extra credit. As long as you watch the videos this class shouldn't be that hard to pass.

Professor Lee uses a textbook she wrote with another professor, and pretty much just reads straight from the slides in the lecture videos. She seems really nice and gave a ton of extra credit, but the class seemed much harder than it needed to be. It was hard to get a good grasp on the material.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Asynchronous class - just watch her videos and take the quizzes. Lecture vids were pretty good, idk what everyone else is complaining abt. Just watch her vids and take notes and you'll be set for quizzes. Exams were just quiz questions so there's no reason to do bad on them. She's so much easier compared to the other CSCE222 profs.

Dr. Lee taught this class about as well as one could expect given that it is an asynchronous class. Just get ready to read the textbook (a lot) and be ready to learn a lot on your own, but getting an A is definitely doable for this course!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: For the actual understanding of material, I didn't get anything out of her lectures. There's an easier way to explain everything she teaches. However, she gives a lot of opportunities for bonus points/extra credit, and the exams are very similar to the quizzes. So, getting a good letter grade is definitely achievable. She's also very accessible.

Made this class way harder than it needs to be. uses a complicated textbook that she wrote herself. wiling to helpout with grades like dropping test scores but then doesnt help when you are as lost in the course as i am

Worst prof I've ever had. Literally would self teach concepts on my own using youtube and khan academy. AVOID THIS PROF. I am not even a bad student and this is the first class I genuinely struggled in. Her test's where either about random facts or thing's she poorly explained. I could write so much more about her but only 350 character limit.

Absolutely atrocious. Imagine getting paid for your students to teach themselves. Honestly a disgrace. Never take this prof. All she does is read the slides, doesnt explain, tests are a lot in a short amount of time. Legit the worst prof. Horrid. Should not be a prof here.

Just don't bother taking this course with Prof Lee, not worth at all. Taking it right now and I'm probably going to get a B which is fine, but knowing how easy the other professors make this class, there's no reason to take this class with her. I can't judge her personality and Prof Lee as a person, but as an instructor she is absolutely awful.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
Horrible professor. Was not accessible at all, and made rude comments towards anyone asking questions in class. She made a student cry and her response was "Why are you crying you're here to learn not cry"
Her exams include random unimportant facts surrounding the topic. On the final 1/5 of the exam was based on one of these fun facts. DO NOT TAKE

Class is tough because we are learning new topics but quizzes are very similar to exercises and exams very similar to powerpoints. Beware that exams are 25ish questions, so you can only miss a few before your grade drops. Homeworks can be tough but are relatively straight-forward, and she typically stays up for a very long time responding to emails

Taking this professor was genuinely the biggest mistake of my college life. She made things unreasonably difficult for no reason. This class was not meant to be taught in the way she taught it. I would consider myself a very good student, so I know that I studied and tried hard, and I think this class may be my first C. Avoid.

Lee is legit the worst CS prof I've ever had (yes, worse than Ritchey). She made this "easy" class unbelievably hard by asking questions on quizzes and exams that you would normally have to solve with a compiler. Class is way harder than it should be. She also has zero leniency and is overall a spiteful person. AVOID. AVOID. AVOID.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Lee makes this class much harder than necessary as she provides a lot of busy work and makes extremely hard tests. She is very poor at lecturing as she consistently rambles and never says anything of substance. She acts nice but she is ruthless and if you mess up, she will not provide any sort of cushion or help. Avoid at all costs.

The class material is not difficult, but Dr. Lee has not covered enough relevant material during lecture, and elaborates too much on simple concepts. Do not expect any opportunities if you mess up anything as she will simply tell you to "refer to the syllabus" and give zeros. Avoid taking her class at all costs!

I think Dr. Lee is a bad prof, this should be a class where students and introduced the basics of programming languages and is not done very well. Chalk it up to poor students; but, you can't leave the fault off of her for having a class GPA well below 3.0, some, if not all, of the credit has to go to how bad this class is taught and graded. AVOID!
Learned nothing during lectures. Exams are incredibly difficult. Makes the class way too difficult. Don't take this professor.

She tries to act really friendly and fun in the class but acts completely different outside of class. When you approach her with a problem(regarding grades and stuff), she tends to deviate from it and just doesn't help. Instead, she'd just say: "Learn from your mistakes". If you want a normal semester, I'd recommend not taking her at all.

Dr. Lee takes the term "awful prof" to a whole new level. Her HW prompts are some of the vaguest thing I've ever seen. 3 exams are worth 60% of your grade and they all have 24-28 MCQ questions (If you miss 3 or more, well you'll get a B on that exam). Exam averages are consistently D+/C- and no class curve whatsoever. DO NOT TAKE HER for your sake!

Dr. Lee is not necessarily a mean person, but she is way too harsh for a sophomore level elective class. Haskell homeworks are very time consuming and in-class quizzes are difficult (closed note, closed everything). The people saying she's good are putting in a lot more effort than this course should require. Do not take if at all possible.

Those rating Lee as a bad professor are just mad cause they didn't do what they were supposed to and paid the price in their grade for it. One of the most accessible (via multiple channels of communication), helpful, and caring professors I have ever had. She goes fast and expects you to study hard, but everything you need to succeed is provided.

Dr. Lee made 222 harder than it should've been. Her lecture slides don't contain enough information and she tends to not go into depth into concepts. Also doesn't provide alot of examples. She assigns one homework and quiz a week. The homework is done in Latex which takes up even more time. Also don't have enough time on exams usually either.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Shes a super nice lady but not a good teacher and makes the class so much harder than it needs to be.

Professor Lee is the toughest professor I have ever taken. She does a terrible job of explaining concepts in a way that will make sense to her audience, meaning she uses terminology most students taking her class will not understand. Everything is the students' fault, never her own. Takes off points for everything. Avoid this prof at all costs.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee is sweet person, but she is a very tough professor. Please take someone else if possible.

Dr. Lee is one of the most caring professors I've had. So far I've had her extend the available time for a quiz by 24 hours and the submission time for a homework by 12 hours within hours of me emailing her when I just didn't have enough time. Homeworks aren't awful as long as you are aware of the extra time you'll need to format. Exams are MC.

Dr. Lee makes me question what it takes to be a dr. How does someone write a textbook and the slides and fail to elaborate on any of the material? Consistently has the lowest student averages of any prof teaching this class, and after week 3, you understand why. Curves are weak and sympathy is nonexistent. Avoid at all costs, teach yourself first.

Dr. Lee is very sweet, however her lectures are very confusing she rarely explains anything fully and things students can just understand by doing one VERY simple example. The homework's are not super hard, however when it comes times for the quizzes and tests, there is very little supplementary material to practice with. Save your time.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee is nice, but she's an awful prof. She's really bad at explaining things and can't make a PowerPoint to save her life so lectures are basically pointless. She lacks self-awareness to an astonishing degree. Our midterm average was a 64 and a good portion of our class is failing; her solution was making quizzes in person like that'll help us.

Lee is the worst professor you can have for this class. Not only, does everyone fail her quizzes and tests, she does not think to herself why everyone is doing so bad. The lectures and textbook, that she makes, are useless. Her only strength is that she can explain things in the most confusing way possible, that's why everyone is lost in lectures.

Prof. Lee is extremely nice and her lectures are okay. The hws are fairly easy to complete along with her exercises. The quizzes sometimes ask really specific things from the lecture slides, so be sure to memorize everything from the slides. The tests are exactly like the quizzes and exercises, so if you study the quizzes you should do fine.

Dr. Lee is an amazing prof. Her quizzes and exams are really fair. Her homeworks and exercises added to my learning. She's really sweet and she emails back really fast. Definitely take her if you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee is a very nice professor, but she does not do well with explaining the material. She posts some lecture videos, but they are short and not very helpful. For tests and quizzes she asks questions that require a very deep understanding of the material, which she doesn't prepare students for. Reading the book for the Haskell portion helps a lot
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr Lee is nice but CSCE314 is a tough class and often you will be teaching yourself concepts because the lectures do not adequately cover the material. The homeworks are fairly easy but the tests are very hard. The first part of the course is learning Haskell and is the worst part. The Java portion is much easier to understand.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee is a nice person but a terrible teacher. She expects her students to figure out complex theoretical computer science from just one simple example she poorly explains. She thinks we are all PhDs in csce and her exams are too difficult given the time she allows. Nobody in her 314 class this semester is going to pass. She expects too much.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Mrs. Lee is easily one of the most confusing teacher's I've ever had at TAMU. It's not necessarily that she's a bad person, she just can't convey concepts very well to students. Most of what I learned I had to do on my own after realizing half her examples make absolutely no sense without context. So much extra credit though

Awful. Terrible. Bad in every way. There is no "curves galore" like one of the other reviews said. So do not think even for a second you will get a curve. Tests are way too hard and average is probably a 50 or a 60 im guessing. Do not take. Again, do NOT take. One more time, DO NOT take.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is a caring professor and is extremely passionate about the subject. However, she is the most difficult 222 professor at A&M. Her test averages were anywhere from 10%-20% below the other professors and she rarely curves. Before exams she never gives out reviews, prior exams, or homework answers for studying. If you care about GPA I'd avoid her.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee is one of the most caring profs I've encountered. She will consistently bend over backwards to help students (she was getting 4 hours of sleep a night last semester because of all the accomodations she made to us during the COVID online semester). Gives great lectures and gives homework that helps on quizzes and tests. Highly recommend!

Lee is a fair prof, cares about her students, and loves to answer questions. Although a bit slow during lecture, her daily (paper) quizzes/exercises help understand the material. She also responds to emails quickly and answers diligently. Her homework instructions are clear and a balanced time commitment. However, the 2 exams are worth 30% each.

You hear a lot of reviews about professors who "genuinely care" about their students, but with Dr. Lee you can really feel that. In all honesty, 222 is not a fun class. It gets confusing and difficult and sometimes makes no sense, but Dr. Lee is an unbelievable teacher and really makes her class enjoyable. I would highly recommend her.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee's lack of english communication skills started to interfere with learning in lecture. She doesn't know how to convey the heavy logic grammar this class requires in order to be successful. Save yourself and take a prof who can speak english. Weekly quizzes over stuff barely learned, daily worksheets to prevent u from skipping. Tests not bad
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: 314 is a very difficult class: lots of homework, reading, and only 2 exams worth 30% each. Dr. Lee is a great professor, and you would really learn what she's teaching, but it's so hard. The 1st half of the class is Haskell, the 2nd half is Java. By the time the final comes, you are overwhelmed with Java and forget Haskell. That kills on the final.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: HOMEWORKS, QUIZZES, AND EXERCISES! If you do them properly, this class will be manageable. Questions in the exam come directly from the lectures, exercises, quizzes and past exams. Final is 60 percent from EXAM 1 and 2. Take her but you need to work for the grade. DONT MISS ANY HWS. Also, you have to use latex for hw.

From what I hear with students with other professors, 222 is a tough class whichever way you put it with any prof. You can try and take the easier way out with someone else but if you take it with Lee you will learn the stuff, and you will achieve the grade you want if you put in the work.
This class is difficult. Homework was hard and exams were not congruent with quizzes and other class work. She also can be hard to understand and rushes through most lectures.

This class is very difficult and Prof Lee doesn't help. The exams are very difficult and its impossible to get partial credit. The homework is also pretty difficult. Her lectures are very hard to understand so you have to take the time to understand on your own. If you are trying to get a good grade, this is not the prof.

Lee is an interesting prof. She is really nice caring about our learning but makes you work for it. Each week she would assign homework that wasn't too long (just be prepared to spend 4-6 hours a week on it).The thing that makes her class difficult is her test, they are too long. They are not too difficult but they are a time crunch.

Very caring and knowledgeable lady, but not the best prof. She tends to go off on tangents a lot (she gave us a 20 minute lecture on Korean dating life once), and she's already kinda slow to cover the material as it is, so you'll be left to learn a lot of it on your own time. Overall okay, but I would recommend taking Sarin over her.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee is an amazing person. She is helpful, kind, insightful, and one of the smartest people you'll ever meet. But her homework, lectures, and tests are incongruent, and her lectures are not that great. She skips steps in her explanation, and there are not enough practice problems and examples to understand what her expectations are on the test.

I really recommend taking Dr. Lee's class. She always manages to brighten up the classroom with her infectious happiness. She tries her best to teach her students with a smile. She even brought us chocolates for valentine's day :). Dr. Lee definitely gave us a lot of homework but it really helped me w/ learning the material. AND curves/ec galore!
Hard to understand but doable. Highly recommend taking Sze over her or any prof that can at least speak english.

I kept looking at Dr. Lee's reviews thinking somebody else would say it, and no one ever did. Dr. Lee is an absolute inspiration. It's easy to go to lecture and get bogged down into a subject, but Dr. Lee made the class rejuvenating. The work load gets easier, she is great when it comes to ex. credit, and she makes me want to be a better CSCE major
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's a pretty good prof. She goes over everything that's on the hw, gives a list of what's going to be on the exams, and is plenty willing to work with her students.  I didn't super love her lectures, but she posts slides and answer keys that are pretty helpful!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Submit all the homework and any extra credit she offer. I highly recommend doing the homework progressively throughout the week to prevent cramming the day before it is due. Go to class. She can be very hard to understand at times because of her accent and inability to understand that we can't read novels off ppts and retain all the information.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Do the homework. Exams are tough but its over her lecture and class work so if you attend class and do the in class work you will be okay. Shes very nice, and sweet. Sometimes she will give extra credit or curve.

To take her you need to copy all of the notes from the powerpoints, sit in the front of the class. Actually do the homework instead of chegging it. And as for the test, the questions will come from the homework and the powerpoints. Like directly.

Dr. Lee cares about her students and want them to learn. I found her hard to understand and did not get very much out of her lectures. I watched a lot of youtube videos and spent a lot of time in TA office hours. She wants you to really understand the proofs she goes over.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee is one of my favorite professors for CSCE courses. Her assignments are tough, but she is probably the most helpful professor outside of class that I've taken. I had her for 222 and made sure to get her for 314 as well. I definitely recommend her.

The class is pretty difficult. There are about 8 homeworks and you have to type it in latex. Also there is a quiz almost every day. The tests, she expected almost a masterly level of understanding. I feel the material is not hard but the way she taught it was very difficult to understand. She is a nice lady though. No curve for the summer session.

Lee is a decent professor, her accent is a little thick but understandable. Her class is a very difficult one and she moves fast so pay attention or you will be lost. She assigns a lot of homework so make sure you start it early. She doesn't like laziness so don't expect her to cut you any slack, you definitely have to work for it.

Hyunyoung Lee is a professor who really wants you to learn, she does have an accent but you can clear hear her. The problem was the proofs, she would take the whole 50 min class to deeply explain one proof and when the tests and quizzes came around it would be done a whole lot differently. Expect to be reading that book if you want an A.
Hard to follow her lectures, but Dr. Lee is really sweet and wants her students to learn. With additional help and reading outside of class, it's possible to make an A or B.
